fields.name: status
fields.description: `"persisted_steam_id"`: the account or character already had a Steam id, and the server did not check the ticket. `"steam_ticket_verified"`: Steam accepted the ticket.

fields.name: pid
fields.description: The Steam id: 16 to 20 digits as a string (node/server_functions.js:873-877; adventure_functions.js:35 for a ticket).

senders.what: `verify_tauri_steam_auth`, from the `auth` handler with `epl: "tauri_steam"`. It comes before `start`.
